name: AUTH-002 Login Orchestrator Implementation
objective: Implement Login Orchestrator per AUTH-002 spec - coordinates login workflow by delegating to Authentication Engine, Network Layer, Security Layer, Session Layer, Cookie Layer, and Portal Layer
exit_criteria: ILoginOrchestrator is the single public login workflow entry point
All 12 workflow steps execute in correct order
No direct HTTP calls from LoginOrchestrator
Security validation via ISecurityMonitor before login
All 8 workflow lifecycle events published correctly
IPortalConnector wraps PortalSDK without duplicating logic
LoginOrchestrator registered in ServiceRegistry and DependencyRegistry
